scope: Modern representations of dated available historical items, with selected documented creative-inventory entry/removal boundaries. Not a complete executable reconstruction of every original creative catalog, numeric-ID order, pixel geometry, or early registry. Existing coarse release-family profiles remain coarse; no new terrain versions or registry removal.

layout.implementation: Own simple shaded panel, scroll and mouse handling; vanilla runtime item renderer, no third-party GUI assets copied.

aliases.leather armor: Modern representation of old cloth armor; the separate leather material and milk bucket only enter the represented Alpha1.0.11 profile, after their Alpha1.0.8 introduction. Buckets enter Alpha1.0.1, after June15 and the last declared June11 Infdev profile.

aliases.blue/brown/black/white dye: Old counterparts are lapis/cocoa/ink/bone meal; modern separate dye items are excluded.

authority.scope: Creative new grants/duplicates only; ordinary worlds and stored loads/saves/normal server-owned container movement are not filtered.
authority.positiveData: Unknown/modded IDs refused only in known historical scope. Item count, enchantment dates/levels and potion variant/effects checked. Unknown rich components compared against default item representation after allowing names/lore/wear/repair and dated supported variants; real stacks are never sanitized.
authority.conservation: Unavailable owned slot writes are frozen on both removal and replacement; unavailable incoming grants and drops refused. Identical rich no-op packets canceled before vanilla block-entity coordinate-copy rewriting. Full inventory/current menu and cursor resynchronized from server truth. Such stacks must be moved using normal chest or Survival inventory operations, not raw creative writes.
authority.clone: Server menu CLONE and clone-style QUICK_CRAFT cannot duplicate unavailable stacks; normal ownership-conserving pickup/swap/transfer/drop untouched.
authority.thread: Packet hook runs after native PacketUtils main-thread dispatch, before native NBT copying and inventory writes. Native permission/count/drop checks remain for accepted requests.

limitations: Exact original numeric-ID ordering and pixel artwork not reproduced; no copyrighted Minecraft GUI implementation/textures copied.

This curated positive catalog intentionally excludes unverified/special command-only items; not claimed exhaustive. Earliest pre-Beta presentation is a convenience creative mode over the existing profiles, not a claim that those versions originally had Creative.
Only declared historical profiles are gated. Later target profiles not yet registered are not invented here.
Native replacement layout remains the host's tabbed GUI with filtered working lists, not a full restoration of every release's tab layout.
